performance_claim_scope: Counterbalanced actual-weight Qwen3.6-27B root leaves on W7900 and RX 7900 XTX, a call-normalized W7900 AR plus natural-B3 trace, and the complete W7900 ten-prompt natural25 AR/B1/B2/B3 packet. The packet is diagnostic and does not replace the canonical topline.
correctness_scope: Temporary CPU-reference Q6_K gates, source-batched versus repeated-source-c1 FP32 identity, actual-root KL/top-1, complete W7900 B1-B3 transaction/state/provider equality, natural-suite exact greedy IDs, GPU/CPU acceptance agreement, and clean teardown.

software.candidate_state: uncommitted temporary implementation, fully removed before publication

source_audit.mechanism: Reproduce Vulkan's AMD floating Q6_K matvec association over the existing byte-neutral planar-qmicro owner: one local32 wave, two adjacent output rows, two half-wave QK-block partitions, four nested scaled segment sums, and every activation row.
source_audit.why_previous_coverage_was_incomplete: The prior root ladder covered exact local128 col8/col4 and scalar-DP4A, but not Vulkan's floating local32/col2 association. The review also found that the first local64 experiment emulated the retained reduction tree rather than packing independent source waves, so both independent-wave packing and per-wave output widening were screened before closure.
source_audit.weight_ownership: No new resident bytes or workspace; every temporary leaf consumed the existing 1,042,944,000-byte root planar-qmicro allocation.

actual_weight_local32_col2.protocol: W7900, 25 warmup pairs, 15 counterbalanced samples, five launches/sample; final two-arm control versus source candidate.
actual_weight_local32_col2.correctness: All actual-root rows preserve top-1; maximum KL versus retained planar output is 1.873e-15 and maximum absolute FP32 delta is 1.78814e-7. Temporary synthetic tests also passed the project CPU-reference KL/top-1 gate.

old_tree_local64_col4.purpose: Preserve retained scalar association so verifier rows would not require a source c1 route.

independent_source_wave_packing.result: All outputs are FP32-bit identical. W7900 and XTX changes versus local32 are mixed and below 1%; no wider workgroup is retained.

source_output_widening.result: Col8 loses decisively. Dedicated col4 improves rows2-4 but worsens the required c1 owner on both cards.

transaction_requirement.initial_failure: Routing only verifier rows changed target logits versus scalar AR by up to 2.86e-6 because the source shader uses a different FP32 association.
transaction_requirement.repair: Route source-association c1 and rows2-4 together. Temporary tests prove every batched source output FP32-bit equal to repeated source c1, and the complete B1-B3 transaction then passes.
transaction_requirement.consequence: The c1 route is not optional: keeping the faster retained scalar owner while selecting source verifier rows violates the exact transaction contract.

call_normalized_profile.protocol: Separate cached compiler-free W7900 rocprofv3 kernel/marker/copy traces of code_merge_intervals natural25 AR followed by B3. Counts and exact family replacements match; microbench direction independently agrees.
call_normalized_profile.best_col4_bound: Replacing only candidate row4 with the faster source-col4 leaf cannot make the package robustly positive: on W7900 its approximately 1.80-ms row4 saving is still consumed by the required approximately 2.04-ms source-c1 penalty, while XTX's c1 penalty is larger.

natural25.protocol: W7900 ten-prompt code/general_en/general_ja/mixed_ja_en suite, true AR plus B1-B3, one warmup and one measured run per route, 25 visible outputs / 24 timed transitions.
natural25.interpretation: The one-run aggregate is positive, but it conflicts with both counterbalanced c1 leaves and the exact call-normalized root family. It is treated as whole-run clock/queue variance, not as evidence to retain a package that increases the intended root work.

kernel_trace_smoke.note: Synthetic N256/K512 CPU-reference test trace; production timing comes from actual output.weight screens and the full profile.

validation.lineage: python3 scripts/check_lineage.py --kind kernel --diff stat completed; only the previously documented unrelated nano-vllm-amd drift was reported.
validation.focused: The temporary CPU/GPU root kernel, dispatch, rollback, and lm-head bundle passed in full on RX 7900 XTX.
validation.w7900_transaction: tests/test_qwen35_gguf_mtp_e2e.py::test_dense_q4_k_m_nextn_transaction_and_provider_match_scalar_ar passed after the source c1/rowtile association repair; review reran it after removing the unused old-association diagnostic, before final candidate removal. The restored production tree is byte-identical to already-gated a934a65af.
validation.cleanup: All temporary HIP, Python wrappers, registry keys, dispatch selectors, environment flags, and tests were removed. git status returned clean before documentation publication.

decision.reason: The source rowtile is fast and numerically safe, but exact transactional semantics require the matching source c1 owner. That singleton runs often enough to make MTP root work 2.050% slower and all traced root work 2.505% slower. Wider source columns/wave packing and an old-association exact sibling do not repair the package on both gfx1100 cards.
decision.next_target: Advance D27-R2 to final module-closure accounting; do not repeat root geometry without a materially new association-preserving c1 primitive or changed source/compiler/model.
